commonPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / production 2D game environment asset.
Input image 1 is the EXISTING transparent basketball-court layer to redesign. Input image 2 is ONLY supporting reference of how that layer sits in the existing game. Match image 1's soft hand-painted ink/gouache collage texture, detail density, dark cold desaturated blue-grey palette and low-contrast lighting exactly. Output a SINGLE clean game-ready environmental LAYER on ACTUAL ALPHA TRANSPARENCY, landscape 16:9, designed on a 960x540 coordinate grid. This is a reusable sprite layer, NOT concept art, NOT a screenshot, NOT a poster.
LOCKED CAMERA: eye-level side-on 2D game view with shallow receding ground, vertical hoop/posts and nearly horizontal far fence. No bird's-eye view, isometric view, camera tilt, camera movement, zoom, panels or storyboard. Preserve the current game's composition scale: far fence base around y=310..330, open marked court ground in y=330..500, empty playable area around x=140..820,y=350..440, hoop on back-left around x=180 with backboard near y=100. Have enough floor for a hero standing at (480,385), but DO NOT draw any hero.
OPAQUE pixels on court pavement, no feathered borders, no gradient fading of pavement, no translucent duplicated ground. Sharp natural physical edges and painted contact shadows, ordinary antialiasing only. The upper empty area and all areas outside the environmental footprint MUST be genuinely transparent; preserve alpha through the fence mesh. No black or coloured backdrop, NO checkerboard drawn as pixels. Include only hoop, fencing as specified, marked asphalt, necessary curb/path and sparse dull fallen leaves. No apartment buildings, skyline, sky, fog, trees, wires or broad foreground branches: those already exist in separate game layers. No people, silhouettes, stars, meteors, UI, logos, captions, numbers, letters, arrows, diagrams or watermarks. No warm/golden light, no photorealistic/3D render, no pixel art. Keep a clear left entry and a clear right exit so the game can animate one existing hero separately. All eight variants use this same fixed camera and native visual style.

variants.name: Чёткий стык
variants.detail: VARIANT 1: nearest to existing court. Full broad court foreground reaches bottom of frame. Its LEFT boundary slopes gently from (110,330) to (0,540), with a sharp weathered low concrete curb separating the court from transparent outside runner street. Gap in this curb and left side fence centered around y=438, wide enough for one character, with a flush small concrete threshold. Far fence and single hoop as original. Natural dirt and cracks along the hard curb conceal the texture joint. Outer left of sloping edge is TRANSPARENT. No front fence cutting across the player area. Clear corresponding right side exit. One asset only.
